summary: Iteration 87: Complete testing of NPS/PPF SIP auto-expense repair endpoint and Monthly Expense Calendar View. All backend tests (100% - 11/11 passed) and frontend features (100%) verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features working correctly: (1) POST /api/investments/repair-expenses finds investments with autoCreateExpense=True but missing linked expense, creates the expense - idempotent endpoint returns repaired=0 on subsequent calls since all were fixed. (2) Expense Calendar at /expense-calendar shows monthly grid with expense dots on due dates, day amounts (e.g. ₹67K on 5th), clicking day shows expense detail list, month selector navigates between months, View as List button navigates to /my-expenses, calendar icon on /my-expenses header navigates to /expense-calendar, legend shows Paid/Pending/Prepaid indicators.

backend_repair_expenses_endpoint.details: POST /api/investments/repair-expenses exists and returns {repaired: int, details: []}

backend_repair_expenses_idempotent.details: Calling repair-expenses twice returns repaired=0 on second call (already fixed)

backend_ppf_sip_creates_expense.details: PPF investment with autoCreateExpense=True creates linked expense with SIP - name format

backend_nps_sip_creates_expense.details: NPS investment with autoCreateExpense=True creates linked expense correctly

backend_expenses_by_month_endpoint.details: GET /api/expenses/by-month returns expenses for calendar view with _displayStatus field

frontend_expense_calendar_route.details: /expense-calendar page loads with calendar grid showing expense dots on due dates

frontend_calendar_day_amounts.details: Calendar shows day amounts (e.g. ₹67K on 5th, ₹50K on 1st)

frontend_calendar_day_detail.details: Clicking a calendar day shows expense detail list below with expense name, category, amount, status

frontend_calendar_month_selector.details: Month selector with prev/next arrows navigates between months (Jan-Mar 2026 tested)

frontend_view_as_list_button.details: 'View as List' button at bottom navigates to /my-expenses

frontend_calendar_icon_button.details: Calendar icon button on /my-expenses header navigates to /expense-calendar

frontend_calendar_legend.details: Legend shows Paid (green), Pending (orange), Prepaid (blue) indicators

frontend_mobile_responsive.details: Calendar displays correctly on mobile viewport (390x844)
